## Change

Describe the user-visible and operational effect.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Lint, type checks, and tests pass locally.
- [ ] Database changes are backward compatible and include a migration.
- [ ] Security, tenant isolation, authorization, and secret handling were reviewed.
- [ ] Operational documentation and rollback steps were updated when required.
- [ ] No credential, token, customer data, or mutable production image tag was committed.

## Rollback

Describe the safe application rollback and any database compatibility constraint.
